purpose: Synthetic calendar-boundary check of experimental forecast helper
fit_availability: Each invented fit is available at 00:00 UTC on the first day of its named month.

observations.result: At least 30 available monthly fits required

limitations: The helper documents its UTC calendar; this demonstrates a potential mismatch with a New York calendar, not a violation of that interface.
All fits and values are invented; no real decision or stock forecast was made.
This check does not establish the published model's exact month-boundary convention.
